lifecycleMap.description.message: The manual's user stories across the lifecycle: what each role does, in which phase and at which level.

lifecycleMap.lead.message: Each card is a user story from a chapter, in the phase where it happens and in the lane of the role that does it. Choose your role and the application level.

lifecycleMap.phase.planeamento.desc.message: Kick-off, application classification, requirements, backlog and prioritisation.

lifecycleMap.phase.design.desc.message: Architecture and threat modelling, with their reviews and approvals.

lifecycleMap.phase.desenvolvimento.desc.message: Code, dependencies, local checks, pull requests and code review.

lifecycleMap.phase.build-ci.desc.message: Build, CI/CD pipeline, automated scanners, SBOM and runners.

lifecycleMap.phase.release.desc.message: Staging, pre-release, promotion gates, deployment and go-live.

lifecycleMap.phase.operacao.desc.message: Production, runtime, monitoring, incidents, patching and decommissioning.

lifecycleMap.phase.transversal.desc.message: Not a point in the lifecycle: governance, audit and compliance, onboarding and training of people, and the continuous cycle (periodic or event-driven reviews, exceptions, KPIs).
